title: WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce WhatIf-Bench, a benchmark measuring how well forecasters use covariates to forecast a target's response to future events.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent time series foundation models (TSFMs) can consume covariates in-context, extending zero-shot forecasting to problems driven by external factors.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and simple regression baselines, we find the LLMs reach the highest skill (improvement over a naive baseline), ahead of the best TSFMs.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Varying the number of covariates, historical events, and event length yields 37,665 tasks.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: WhatIf-Bench reveals generalization to Novel futures as the core challenge, and offers a testbed toward arbitrary scenario analysis.
